profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer for Kiewit Data Services
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack software engineer and manager currently based in Omaha. I love working on user-facing products and improving user experience. I also have a passion for volunteer teaching and improving diversity in tech.



Gallup Strengths: Analytical, Achiever, Relator, Learner, Intellection

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working closely with internal clients and leading a small development team to build a customized billing solution. Focus on maintaining data integrity while automating and speeding up repetitive portions of the billing process. Provide scale to handle increasing volumes of data and flexible customized features for each project/client.

Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, etc.
Roles: Web Developer and Tech Lead. Transitioned to Full-Stack Developer and Manager

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented database updates to store multiple new types of prompts and the associated user responses.
- Updated APIs to send the new prompt types to various frontend apps.
- Worked with the frontend engineer to establish data contracts and adjusted some frontend handling myself once new prompt styles were finalized.
- Updated the prompt recommendation algorithm.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Updated the prompt page to allow for endless swiping on prompts by removing hardcoded elements and adding pre-fetching and caching.
- Updated frontend code to allow for new prompt types while handling the legacy prompt style seamlessly.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the creation of reusable React components and styles for the new SiriusXM app as Development Lead for TV platforms on the UIToolkit squad, making critical architecture decisions and assigning tasks for the platform team.
- Led close collaboration with designers, product managers, and other engineering leads to ensure consistent cross-platform implementation for UIToolkit.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Improved feature parity for the Pandora application on HTML5-based television platforms and devices with React, leading to a more consistent user experience across all platforms.
- Continued to provide essential support to the Web team through domain expertise, mentoring, and interviewing.
- Implemented annual enhancements to the Pandora Playback site for end-of-year statistics, collaborating closely with UX researchers, designers, backend engineers, and data scientists.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Note: Pandora was acquired by SiriusXM in Feb 2019, but I continued working on the Pandora product for some time.
As an engineer on the Pandora Web team, I implemented features and quality of service improvements related to user settings, authorization and signup flows, and payments, including 3rd-party partnerships with companies like T-Mobile and Branch.io.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Implemented the Web version of the Queue feature, which allows users to line up content to play after their current music source ends. Interfaced with the existing backend for the mobile-first feature and added the necessary UI elements. Learned React and Redux on the job.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description: As a member of the MPages development team, I created a JavaScript library to improve the communication of software changes to users. The library allows documentation teams to create walkthrough content for users to see directly on a page, describing new features or changes and visually highlighting the associated area of the page. This will function as both an onboarding tool and a replacement for the changelogs that most users don't read.
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · User Experience (UX) · Web Technologies · Application Development · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Accounting squad - Internal software development and upkeep for the Accounting department using agile methods.
Operations squad - Complete ownership of Spreetail's first client-facing microservice, including creation of the service from planning to full implementation.
Development using C#.Net, JavaScript, and HTML 5 with Entity Framework
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · ASP.NET MVC · Web Technologies · Application Development · JavaScript

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Performed lifeguard duties at Matt Ross Community Center, enforcing rules, ensuring the patrons’ safety, and maintaining the pool area.

positions.title: Design Studio Intern
positions.description: Assisted with the development of a medical web app for Together+Clinic that facilitated doctor-patient communication and outpatient care. Worked in Visual Studio and GitHub with C#, ASP.Net, HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · C# · GitHub · Visual Studio · HTML5 · JavaScript · ASP.NET

company.name: Jeffrey S. Raikes School of Computer Science & Management Design Studio

volunteerExperiences.description: Co-teach an Advanced curriculum of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and professional skills to local high school students on a weekly basis. Mentor current students and alumni. Assist with special events such as hackathons.
Discuss and make influential decisions about the future of Code Nation course content and sequencing. Optimize the curriculum to best prepare our students for jobs in tech.
